## Story
a0e4-18cf-36e9-4648 — As CI, I want the three calibration tracking tickets bootstrapped before the first calibration-rollup workflow run

## testing_mode: GREEN

## What to do
Create `.claude/scripts/dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh`:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DSO="$SCRIPT_DIR/dso"

bootstrap_ticket() {
  local alias="$1" title="$2" desc="$3"
  if "$DSO" ticket exists "$alias" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "bootstrap: $alias already exists — skipping"
  else
    "$DSO" ticket create story "$title" --alias="$alias" --description="$desc"
    echo "bootstrap: $alias created"
  fi
}

bootstrap_ticket "calibration-program-health" \
  "Calibration program health — rollup tracking ticket" \
  "Tracking ticket for calibration-report.sh monthly and quarterly health rollups. Accumulates rollup comment records. Created by dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh."

bootstrap_ticket "mutation-history" \
  "Mutation test history — calibration tracking ticket" \
  "Tracking ticket for calibration-report.sh mutation-append accumulation. Each CI run appends a mutation score record. Created by dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh."

bootstrap_ticket "suite-churn-history" \
  "Suite churn history — calibration tracking ticket" \
  "Tracking ticket for calibration-report.sh churn-append accumulation. Each CI run appends a suite churn record. Created by dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh."
```

Run `chmod +x .claude/scripts/dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh` immediately after creating.
Verify git tracks it as mode 100755: `git ls-files --stage .claude/scripts/dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh` should show 100755.

## Verify
Run: bash tests/scripts/test-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh
Expected: all 4 tests PASS GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: script creates all 3 tickets when missing, is no-op when present
- dd-2: after script runs, dso ticket exists <alias> returns exit 0 for all 3
- dd-4: executable bit set (mode 100755 in git)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] File created at .claude/scripts/dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh
- [ ] chmod +x applied immediately
- [ ] git ls-files --stage shows 100755 for the file
- [ ] All 4 test-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh tests PASS GREEN
- [ ] Second invocation of the script produces 0 "ticket create" calls (idempotent)
data.title: GREEN: create .claude/scripts/dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh with exists-check-then-create
